---
title: "Test the shared research palette"
output: html_notebook
---

This smoke test verifies the literal supplied hex codes and group mappings.

```{r test-color-mapping}
# Load the shared R code blocks from the new palette module.
root <- getwd()
while (!file.exists(file.path(root, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
    next_root <- dirname(root)
    if (identical(root, next_root)) {
        stop("Open the RStudio project first")
    }
    root <- next_root
}

path <- file.path(root, "R", "plot_palette.Rmd")
lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
starts <- which(startsWith(lines, "```{r"))
ends <- which(trimws(lines) == "```")
for (start in starts) {
    finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
    if (is.na(finish)) {
        stop("Unclosed code chunk")
    }
    expression <- paste(lines[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    eval(parse(text = expression), envir = environment())
}

expected <- c(
    "#c98389", "#954e4b", "#febd97", "#d6c6bc", "#c3a052",
    "#82667a", "#33c2b1", "#125238", "#aa663c"
)
stopifnot(identical(unname(atg_palette), expected))
stopifnot(atg_group_colors[["AI/AN alone"]] == "#33c2b1")
stopifnot(atg_group_colors[["Other identified single-race"]] == "#aa663c")
stopifnot(atg_group_colors[["Unresolved/multiracial"]] == "#c3a052")
stopifnot(atg_model_colors[["logistic"]] == "#aa663c")
stopifnot(atg_model_colors[["lasso"]] == "#33c2b1")
stopifnot(atg_model_colors[["forest"]] == "#c3a052")
stopifnot(atg_model_colors[["prevalence_only"]] == "#125238")
stopifnot(atg_category_colors(c("Missing", "<25k"))[["Missing"]] == "#d6c6bc")

# Draw a small validation chart directly in this notebook; do not save a figure.
plot_data <- data.frame(
    cohort = factor(names(atg_group_colors)[1:2], levels = names(atg_group_colors)[1:2]),
    example_rate = c(0.20, 0.16)
)
plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = cohort, y = example_rate, fill = cohort)
) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    atg_scale_fill_groups() +
    atg_theme() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Palette-only preview - illustrative values",
        x = "Population",
        y = "Illustrative value (not BRFSS results)"
    )
print(plot)
cat("[PASS] Palette and stable group colors validated.\n")
```
